description: Gatsby 5 site with React and Tailwind CSS, built from your description. The page is generated ahead of time and served by gatsby serve; there is no server code.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a marketing page for a gym, a portfolio site, a pricing page, an about page
ui.description: Gatsby page built from your description, generated ahead of time.
